allow: Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$s = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://localhost:3000/api/servers/search?name=a' -TimeoutSec 5; 'search success=' + $s.success + ' count=' + $s.data.Count; $s.data | Select-Object -First 3 _id,name | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$r = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://localhost:3000/api/servers' -TimeoutSec 5; 'servers=' + $r.data.Count; $r.data | Select-Object -First 10 name,memberIds | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $u = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://localhost:3000/api/users' -TimeoutSec 5; 'users=' + $u.data.Count; $u.data | Select-Object -First 10 _id,username,jointServer | ConvertTo-Json -Compress")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$srv = (Invoke-RestMethod 'http://localhost:3000/api/servers').data | Select-Object -First 1; $sid = $srv._id; $bob = '6a9e44bfe117956ef9b85cb1'; $s = Invoke-RestMethod 'http://localhost:3000/api/servers/search?name=SV' -TimeoutSec 5; 'search(SV) count=' + $s.data.Count + ' name=' + $s.data[0].name; $body = @{ userId = $bob } | ConvertTo-Json; $j = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post \"http://localhost:3000/api/servers/$sid/join\" -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 5; 'join success=' + $j.success + ' msg=' + $j.message + ' members=' + ($j.data.memberIds -join ','); $u = (Invoke-RestMethod \"http://localhost:3000/api/users/$bob\" -TimeoutSec 5).data; 'bob jointServer=' + ($u.jointServer -join ','); try { Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post \"http://localhost:3000/api/servers/$sid/join\" -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -TimeoutSec 5 | Out-Null; 'rejoin=NO_ERROR' } catch { 'rejoin status=' + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode }")

Shell(powershell -NoProfile -Command "$sid='6aa18e9a3963cfd3c40d6e20'; function T($label,$sidv,$uid){ try { $b=@{userId=$uid}|ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post \"http://localhost:3000/api/servers/$sidv/join\" -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $b -TimeoutSec 5 | Out-Null; \"$label = NO_ERROR\" } catch { \"$label status=\" + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode } }; T 'invalid userId' $sid 'abc'; T 'nonexistent userId' $sid '000000000000000000000000'; T 'nonexistent serverId' '000000000000000000000000' '6a9e44bfe117956ef9b85cb0'")
